findings.issue: Literal translation misrepresents the structure: it reads like an experiential perfect (言ったことはない 'I have never said it') and renders もはや as 'No'. The sentence is existence-negation of 言うこと: 'by now there is nothing to say'.
findings.current: No, as for having said it, I haven't.
findings.suggested: By now, as for things to say, there are none.

findings.issue: Gloss of よく cites よくない ('não é bom'), a form not in this sentence; here よく is the adverbial form in よくなった ('ficou bom/melhor'). Copy-pasted from another sentence and misleading in context.
findings.current: bem (forma de いい/よい em よくない = não é bom)
findings.suggested: bem (forma adverbial de いい/よい; em よくなった = ficou bom/melhor)

findings.issue: Gloss of よかっ cites よくない ('não é bom'), a form not in this sentence; here it is the past stem in よかった ('teria sido bom'). Copy-pasted gloss, wrong in context.
findings.current: bem (forma de いい/よい em よくない = não é bom)
findings.suggested: bom (forma de いい/よい; raiz do passado em よかった = 'teria sido bom')
